summary: Fresh-context read-only review of all 70 changed files against 79153d6 found no actionable defects. Traced pairing consent/expiry/revocation, cookie refresh and origin/profile isolation, aggregated episode versions with canonical progress, decoder/track eligibility, source-time/pause/remote behavior, serialized replacement, final progress ordering, cancelled loads and session cleanup. Frozen final APK passed 33 unit tests, four focused native regressions and the complete 20-test native suite; physical TV 4K/HDR/audio, actual Young Frankenstein, OAuth and extended recovery remain acceptance gaps.
